_note: "items" is empty -- this channel is entirely series-driven, same shape as channels/science, channels/maker and channels/pet-central. Seven series back the 15-block, 24-hour daily grid in programming.json: five real YouTube imports from official channels (each from the channel's own long-form-only uploads playlist, UULF<channel>, so YouTube Shorts are excluded at the source) and two Internet Archive imports of pre-1931 silent comedy. See each series/<id>/series.json for the full episode list and per-episode editorial status/notes. YouTube episodes carry rights.status "unverified" (YouTube embed only; needs human rights review); Comedy Central Stand-Up, Don't Tell Comedy and Just For Laughs episodes are additionally flagged as mature content unreviewed for content rating and are scheduled only in evening/late-night/overnight blocks. IA episodes are approved only where IA declares public domain AND the film predates 1931.
title: Comedy Club
